_header: Parity fixture for crates/daemon/src/memory/markdown_store.rs + markdown_query.rs -> llm-sidecar/src/memory/markdown_store.ts + markdown_query.ts.

Generated by driving the real Rust MarkdownMemoryStore and markdown_query in a throwaway worktree at 9023b46d (the last commit where the daemon crate builds). The generator is not committed; nothing regenerates this file. A later diff against it is a defect, not a fixture to update.

File contents and free text are base64 so trailing whitespace, CR bytes and the absence of a trailing newline survive. `modified_at` on each entry is a wall clock reading of the file's mtime and cannot be pinned byte for byte; the replay normalises it and checks the format separately.
